fcff_margin_terminal.note: 27.83% → 30% over 5yr. Services revenue grows faster + higher margin (~70% vs ~35% products). Mix shift drives modest expansion.

wacc.note: Sector WACC: cost of equity 9.97% (Rf 4.18% + β 1.35 × ERP 4.23%) × 95.58% E-weight + after-tax cost of debt 3.97% × 4.42% D-weight

terminal_growth.note: Below long-run US GDP ~2.5%; below Rf 4.18%

net_debt.note: Total debt $106,629M (CP $9,967 + current term $10,912 + non-current term $85,750) - Cash & investments $156,650M (cash $29,943 + ST mkt sec $35,228 + LT mkt sec $91,479). Negative = net cash.

buyback_yield.note: ~$110B/yr buyback authorization / ~$3T market cap = 3.5% annual share reduction. AAPL most aggressive buyback in history.

sbc_pct_revenue.note: SBC ~$11.7B / Revenue $391B = 3.0%. Disciplined for tech — AAPL relies less on equity comp than peers.

expected_output.tolerance_rationale: Range covers conservative-textbook DCF (~$120, this record's assumptions) through optimistic bull DCF (~$250, g=10%/margin=30%/WACC=8.5%). Below $80 or above $280 = math bug. Analyst consensus $308 above upper bound — reflects market growth premium (services, AI, buybacks) not captured in pure DCF.
